updateMessage: Movie Hub v3.5.272 is live! Fixed video quality change routing so switching qualities (360p, 720p, 1080p) instantly changes video quality and resumes playback seamlessly.
releaseNotes: v3.5.272: Fixed video quality change routing so selecting 360p, 480p, 720p, or 1080p correctly switches the stream quality on the fly and resumes playback at the exact timestamp. Plus all previous fixes: instant series/movie click-to-play, dual touch gestures, and strictly 2026 releases.
